ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: I grow tomatoes and onions in my garden.
ex.zh: 我在花園種了番茄和洋蔥。

ex.en: My aunt grows tomatoes in her garden.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在她的花園裡種番茄。

ex.en: The policeman didn't tow your car away.
ex.zh: 警察沒有把你的車拖走。

ex.en: My car broke down and had to be towed.
ex.zh: 我的車拋錨了，只好叫拖吊。

ex.en: Cars parked here will be towed.
ex.zh: 停在這裡的車會被拖吊。

ex.en: We called a tow truck after the accident.
ex.zh: 車禍後我們叫了拖吊車。

ex.en: The tow truck arrived in 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 拖吊車三十分鐘後就到了。

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車的最大載重是五噸。

ex.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
ex.zh: 這輛貨車的載重超過三噸。

ex.en: This grizzly bear weighs half a ton.
ex.zh: 這隻灰熊重達半噸。

ton.zh: tons of / a ton of：大量的、很多

ex.en: He left me with tons of hard work to do.
ex.zh: 他丟給我一大堆辛苦的工作。

ex.en: I have tons of emails to answer.
ex.zh: 我有一大堆電子郵件要回。

ex.en: We must pay a toll to drive on this road.
ex.zh: 在這條路上開車必須付通行費。

ex.en: Is there a toll on this highway?
ex.zh: 這條高速公路要收通行費嗎？

toll.zh: take a toll on：對…造成損害

ex.en: Stress can take a toll on your health.
ex.zh: 壓力會傷害你的健康。

ex.en: Long working hours took a toll on him.
ex.zh: 長時間工作把他累壞了。

ex.en: The printer is running out of toner.
ex.zh: 印表機的碳粉快用完了。

ex.en: Can you order more toner for the copier?
ex.zh: 你可以幫影印機多訂一些碳粉嗎？

ex.en: Apply toner after washing your face.
ex.zh: 洗完臉後擦化妝水。

ex.en: This toner is good for oily skin.
ex.zh: 這款化妝水適合油性肌膚。

toiletry.zh: 盥洗用品（常用複數 toiletries）

ex.en: Don't forget to pack your toiletries.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶盥洗用品。

ex.en: The hotel provides free toiletries in every room.
ex.zh: 飯店每間房都提供免費的盥洗用品。

ex.en: We'd like to order 18 tonnes of olive oil.
ex.zh: 我們想訂購 18 公噸的橄欖油。

ex.en: The truck can carry ten tonnes of goods.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車可以載十公噸的貨。

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was torture.
ex.zh: 等考試結果真是一種折磨。

ex.en: Sitting in traffic for two hours is pure torture.
ex.zh: 塞車塞了兩個小時簡直是酷刑。

ex.en: Stop torturing yourself about the mistake.
ex.zh: 別再為那個錯誤折磨自己了。

ex.en: He was tortured by guilt for years.
ex.zh: 他多年來飽受罪惡感折磨。

ex.en: The room smelled of tobacco.
ex.zh: 房間裡有菸味。

ex.en: Today is World No Tobacco Day.
ex.zh: 今天是世界無菸日。

ex.en: The government raised taxes on tobacco.
ex.zh: 政府調高了菸品稅。

ex.en: Negligence is a common type of tort.
ex.zh: 過失是常見的侵權行為類型。

ex.en: She studied tort law at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學讀過侵權法。

ex.en: I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了這個噪音了。

ex.en: I cannot tolerate his actions.
ex.zh: 我無法容忍他的行為。

ex.en: The company does not tolerate rudeness toward customers.
ex.zh: 公司不容許對客人無禮。

ex.en: I walk to the office every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上走路去辦公室。

ex.en: Is this the train to Kaohsiung?
ex.zh: 這是開往高雄的火車嗎？

ex.en: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
ex.zh: 你不應該那樣跟父母頂嘴。

ex.en: Please give the report to Amy.
ex.zh: 請把報告交給艾咪。

ex.en: The store is open from 9 to 6.
ex.zh: 這家店從九點營業到六點。

ex.en: Prices range from $10 to $50.
ex.zh: 價格從十元到五十元不等。

to.zh: to＋原形動詞（不定詞）：去做…；為了…

ex.en: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.
ex.zh: 我會盡量不打擾你唸書。

ex.en: You can't expect me to always think of everything!
ex.zh: 你不能指望我每件事都想得到！

ex.en: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你年紀還太小，不能考駕照。

ex.en: You are too ready to speak ill of others.
ex.zh: 你太愛說別人壞話了。

ex.en: This coffee is too hot.
ex.zh: 這杯咖啡太燙了。

ex.en: I like coffee, too.
ex.zh: 我也喜歡咖啡。

ex.en: Amy is coming to the party, too.
ex.zh: 艾咪也會來派對。

ex.en: Why are there no taxis at the station today?
ex.zh: 為什麼今天車站沒有計程車？

ex.en: I have three meetings today.
ex.zh: 我今天有三個會議。

ex.en: Pretty good. Did you go to today's history seminar?
ex.zh: 還不錯。你去參加今天的歷史研討會了嗎？

ex.en: Today is my first day at the new job.
ex.zh: 今天是我新工作的第一天。

ex.en: English is taught almost all over the world today.
ex.zh: 如今全世界幾乎都在教英語。

ex.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
ex.zh: 如今，我們的人造衛星正環繞著地球運行。

ex.en: English is a very important language in today's world.
ex.zh: 英語在當今世界是非常重要的語言。

ex.en: Today's young people spend a lot of time online.
ex.zh: 現今的年輕人花很多時間上網。

ex.en: I wish that we could spend more time together.
ex.zh: 我希望我們能有更多時間在一起。

ex.en: Tom and Mary always work together as a team.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是組成團隊一起工作。

ex.en: I thought we were going to do this together.
ex.zh: 我以為我們要一起做這件事。

ex.en: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
ex.zh: 他們約好七點在這裡碰面。

ex.en: Let's get together for dinner next week.
ex.zh: 我們下週一起吃個晚餐吧。

ex.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
ex.zh: 那個小鎮離海岸兩英里。

ex.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
ex.zh: 海嘯席捲稻田，淹沒了城鎮。

ex.en: They regarded him as the best doctor in town.
ex.zh: 大家認為他是鎮上最好的醫生。

town.zh: 市區；（out of town）出城、不在本地

ex.en: My manager is out of town this week.
ex.zh: 我的主管這週出差不在。

ex.en: Let's go into town for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們去市區吃晚餐吧。

ex.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們終於抵達山頂。

ex.en: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.
ex.zh: 山頂被雪覆蓋。

ex.en: The cat is sitting on top of the table.
ex.zh: 貓坐在桌子上面。

ex.en: She is one of our top salespeople.
ex.zh: 她是我們頂尖的業務之一。

ex.en: The hotel bar is on the top floor.
ex.zh: 飯店酒吧在頂樓。

ex.en: Sales topped one million dollars.
ex.zh: 銷售額突破一百萬美元。

ex.en: The song topped the charts for weeks.
ex.zh: 這首歌連續好幾週登上排行榜冠軍。

ex.en: On top of that, the train was late.
ex.zh: 更糟的是，火車還誤點了。

ex.en: On top of his salary, he gets a bonus.
ex.zh: 除了薪水之外，他還有獎金。

ex.en: Hundreds of buffaloes moved toward the lake.
ex.zh: 數百頭水牛朝湖邊移動。

ex.en: She keeps on rolling her eyes towards our direction.
ex.zh: 她一直朝我們這邊翻白眼。

ex.en: He often takes a defiant attitude toward us.
ex.zh: 他常對我們採取反抗的態度。

ex.en: What is your attitude toward working overtime?
ex.zh: 你對加班的看法是什麼？

ex.en: Can Edinburgh show us the way towards healthier cities?
ex.zh: 愛丁堡能為我們指出邁向更健康城市的方法嗎？

ex.en: The money will go toward a new office.
ex.zh: 這筆錢將用於新辦公室。

total.zh: 總數、總計（in total / a total of）

ex.en: There are about ten to twenty students in total.
ex.zh: 總共大約有十到二十個學生。

ex.en: This trip of mine would need twelve days in total.
ex.zh: 我這趟旅行總共需要十二天。

ex.en: It caused a total of 60 million deaths.
ex.zh: 總共造成六千萬人死亡。

ex.en: What is the total amount of money you spent?
ex.zh: 你總共花了多少錢？

ex.en: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.
ex.zh: 這項計畫的總支出達一億日圓。

ex.en: Did you see yesterday's total lunar eclipse?
ex.zh: 你看到昨天的月全食了嗎？

ex.en: The party was a total disaster.
ex.zh: 那場派對徹底搞砸了。

ex.en: Sales totaled two million dollars last year.
ex.zh: 去年銷售額總計兩百萬美元。

ex.en: The bill totals 85 dollars.
ex.zh: 帳單總共八十五美元。

ex.en: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
ex.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去打棒球。

ex.en: What will you be doing at this time tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你明天這個時候會在做什麼？

ex.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
ex.zh: 要在明天之前完成報告幾乎不可能。

ex.en: My son is busy studying for the examinations tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我兒子正忙著準備明天的考試。

ex.en: Let go of my arm! I can't stand people touching me.
ex.zh: 放開我的手臂！我受不了別人碰我。

ex.en: The earthworm wriggled when I touched it.
ex.zh: 我碰蚯蚓時，牠扭動了起來。

ex.en: Please don't touch the paintings.
ex.zh: 請勿觸摸畫作。

ex.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
ex.zh: 所有客人都被她的熱情款待感動了。

ex.en: I was touched by his kind words.
ex.zh: 他親切的話讓我很感動。

touch.zh: get / keep in touch：聯絡、保持聯絡

ex.en: There's no way to get in touch with him.
ex.zh: 沒有辦法聯絡上他。

ex.en: I hope we'll be able to keep in touch.
ex.zh: 希望我們能保持聯絡。

ex.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.
ex.zh: 做這件事你會需要特殊的工具。

ex.en: Check the tools and see if anything is missing.
ex.zh: 檢查一下工具，看有沒有少了什麼。

ex.en: These tools are used for building a house.
ex.zh: 這些工具是用來蓋房子的。

ex.en: A computer is a type of modern tool.
ex.zh: 電腦是一種現代工具。

ex.en: Social media is a powerful marketing tool.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是強大的行銷工具。

ex.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.
ex.zh: 我們討論了各式各樣的話題。

ex.en: I chose this topic because I think it's interesting.
ex.zh: 我選這個主題是因為我覺得它很有趣。

ex.en: After ten minutes, they passed on to a new topic.
ex.zh: 十分鐘後，他們換了個新話題。

ex.en: What you've said is totally accurate.
ex.zh: 你說的完全正確。

ex.en: Who said that? It's totally wrong!
ex.zh: 那是誰說的？完全是錯的！

ex.en: Life without love is just totally pointless.
ex.zh: 沒有愛的人生毫無意義。

ex.en: Do you want to go to a movie tonight?
ex.zh: 你今晚想去看電影嗎？

ex.en: Tonight we are planning to go to the concert.
ex.zh: 今晚我們打算去聽音樂會。

ex.en: I heard the weather forecast said it'll rain tonight.
ex.zh: 我聽氣象預報說今晚會下雨。

ex.en: Attending high school in Korea is tough.
ex.zh: 在韓國讀高中很辛苦。

ex.en: Tom certainly has a tough job.
ex.zh: 湯姆的工作確實很不容易。

ex.en: It was a tough decision to make.
ex.zh: 這是個很難做的決定。

ex.en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
ex.zh: 他很堅強，不會輕易灰心。

ex.en: She's a tough competitor, isn't she?
ex.zh: 她是個難纏的對手，對吧？

ex.en: The government is getting tough on drunk driving.
ex.zh: 政府對酒駕的態度越來越強硬。

ex.en: My boss is tough but fair.
ex.zh: 我老闆很嚴格，但很公正。

ex.en: This steak is too tough to chew.
ex.zh: 這塊牛排老到咬不動。

ex.en: The meat was dry and tough.
ex.zh: 這肉又乾又硬。

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來遊客人數大幅增加。

ex.en: The only people who do this are tourists.
ex.zh: 會這樣做的只有觀光客。

ex.en: The tourists were fascinated with the exquisite scenery.
ex.zh: 觀光客被絕美的景色深深吸引。

ex.en: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
ex.zh: 走遍所有觀光景點真的把我累壞了。

ex.en: Jiufen is a popular tourist spot near Taipei.
ex.zh: 九份是台北附近很受歡迎的觀光景點。

ex.en: There was a sudden change in her tone.
ex.zh: 她的語氣突然變了。

ex.en: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?
ex.zh: 你有沒有聽出他說話的語氣怪怪的？

ex.en: She spoke in soft tones.
ex.zh: 她用輕柔的語調說話。

ex.en: Chinese is a language that has four tones.
ex.zh: 中文是有四個聲調的語言。

ex.en: Tones can be hard for English speakers to learn.
ex.zh: 對說英語的人來說，聲調可能很難學。

ex.en: The CEO's speech set a positive tone for the meeting.
ex.zh: 執行長的演講為會議定下了正面的基調。

ex.en: The opening song set the tone for the evening.
ex.zh: 開場歌曲為整個晚上定下了基調。

ex.en: It was her little sister that broke her toy.
ex.zh: 弄壞她玩具的是她妹妹。

ex.en: The toy department is on the fifth floor.
ex.zh: 玩具部在五樓。

ex.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
ex.zh: 我想要一個盒子來收這些玩具。

toy.zh: toy with：把玩；隨便想想（某個主意）

ex.en: She toyed with the idea of moving abroad.
ex.zh: 她有想過要不要搬到國外。

ex.en: He was toying with his pen during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他開會時一直在把玩他的筆。

ex.en: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
ex.zh: 如果牙齒痛，就應該去看牙醫。

ex.en: She said that she brushes her teeth every morning.
ex.zh: 她說她每天早上都會刷牙。

ex.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
ex.zh: 他下巴骨折，還掉了幾顆牙。

ex.en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
ex.zh: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

ex.en: We saw the tower in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們遠遠就看到了那座塔。

ex.en: The school's tallest structure is that water tower.
ex.zh: 學校最高的建築就是那座水塔。

ex.en: New York bristles with towering buildings.
ex.zh: 紐約到處都是高聳的大樓。

ex.en: The new building towers over the old town.
ex.zh: 新大樓高聳在舊城區之上。

ex.en: English is useful in diplomacy and tourism.
ex.zh: 英文在外交和觀光業很有用。

ex.en: Tourism generated many new jobs.
ex.zh: 觀光業創造了許多新的工作機會。

ex.en: Tourism is important to Taiwan's economy.
ex.zh: 觀光業對台灣經濟很重要。

ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
ex.zh: 他拿起一面鏡子檢查自己的舌頭。

ex.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
ex.zh: 我被熱湯燙到舌頭。

ex.en: Translating helps us to know our mother tongue better.
ex.zh: 翻譯能幫助我們更了解自己的母語。

ex.en: English is not her native tongue.
ex.zh: 英文不是她的母語。

tongue.zh: on the tip of one's tongue：話到嘴邊（卻想不起來）

ex.en: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
ex.zh: 他的名字就在嘴邊，可是想不起來。

ex.en: The answer was on the tip of my tongue.
ex.zh: 答案就在嘴邊，卻說不出來。

ex.en: Some cleaning products are toxic.
ex.zh: 有些清潔用品有毒。

ex.en: The factory released toxic waste into the river.
ex.zh: 工廠把有毒廢棄物排進河裡。

toxic.zh: 有害的、惡質的（環境、關係）

ex.en: She quit because of the toxic work environment.
ex.zh: 她因為惡劣的工作環境而離職。

ex.en: It's important to stay away from toxic relationships.
ex.zh: 遠離有害的人際關係很重要。

ex.en: On leaving school, we presented him with a table clock as a token of our thanks.
ex.zh: 我們畢業時送他一個桌鐘，表示我們的謝意。

ex.en: Please accept this gift as a token of our appreciation.
ex.zh: 請收下這份禮物，聊表我們的謝意。

ex.en: You need a token to use the washing machine.
ex.zh: 使用洗衣機需要投代幣。

ex.en: Each player gets ten tokens at the start of the game.
ex.zh: 每位玩家在遊戲開始時拿到十個代幣。

ex.en: The app sends a security token to your phone.
ex.zh: 這個 App 會傳送安全驗證碼到你的手機。

ex.en: The model can process thousands of tokens at once.
ex.zh: 這個模型可以一次處理數千個詞元。

ex.en: The company made only a token effort to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司只是做做樣子地處理這個問題。

ex.en: They charge a token fee for the workshop.
ex.zh: 他們對這場工作坊收取象徵性的費用。

ex.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
ex.zh: 他在西洋棋錦標賽中奪得冠軍。

ex.en: That athlete won three times in a row in this tournament.
ex.zh: 那位選手在這項賽事中三連霸。

ex.en: We have to win seven times in a row to win this tournament.
ex.zh: 我們必須連勝七場才能贏得這次錦標賽。

ex.en: It is said that Dutch are tolerant.
ex.zh: 人們常說荷蘭人很寬容。

ex.en: She is tolerant of other people's opinions.
ex.zh: 她能包容別人的意見。

ex.en: By reading books and discussing concepts, a person can gain wisdom and tolerance of differing ideas.
ex.zh: 透過讀書和討論觀念，人可以獲得智慧，並包容不同的想法。

ex.en: We should show tolerance toward other cultures.
ex.zh: 我們應該包容其他文化。

ex.en: He has a low tolerance for pain.
ex.zh: 他很怕痛。

ex.en: Some people have a high tolerance for spicy food.
ex.zh: 有些人很能吃辣。

ex.en: The parts must be made to a tolerance of 0.1 mm.
ex.zh: 零件的公差必須在 0.1 公釐以內。

ex.en: This machine works within very tight tolerances.
ex.zh: 這台機器的容許誤差非常小。

ex.en: The townhouse has a small courtyard and a private garage.
ex.zh: 這棟連棟住宅有小庭院和私人車庫。

ex.en: They chose a townhouse close to the commuter rail station.
ex.zh: 他們選了一間靠近通勤鐵路站的連棟住宅。

ex.en: The director raised a glass to toast the retiring team leader.
ex.zh: 主管舉杯祝賀即將退休的團隊負責人。

ex.en: Toast the bread lightly before adding the topping.
ex.zh: 先把麵包稍微烤過，再放上配料。

ex.en: She wiped her wet hair with a towel.
ex.zh: 她用毛巾把濕頭髮擦乾。

ex.en: She came out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel.
ex.zh: 她圍著一條浴巾從浴室走了出來。

ex.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
